Triage: `domain:services` (`packages/services/service-datasource/src/external-datasource-service.ts`) · p3 · Bug · `area:api`; rationale: `os datasource introspect` writes a file shape the published docs page denies

`Path: 外部数据源接进来当自己的对象用 | integration-system.datasource-introspect-codegen | P② | p3`
Graded by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`) at 2026-09-22T19:37Z.

**Class (b)**, against the same published contract as #19722: `content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx` declares the `ObjectSchema.create({…})` pattern, and this emitter writes an annotated literal into a file the CLI's own published example tells the user to keep.

⚠️ **Ruling `5644350230` does NOT reach this site**, and this seat checked its text rather than assuming: item ③ names object **files** (examples, templates, fixtures), not emitters. ⇒ this card stands on the published docs page alone, which is enough.

⚠️ **Two riders.** (1) Two authored comment blocks in the emitted output must survive the rewrite. (2) The CLI-side example is a **sibling** change in another package — ⛔ not a rider on this PR; declare it and file it separately if it still disagrees afterwards.

⚠️ Declared file face, because the card carries a lane-split warning: the emitter is `packages/services/service-datasource/src/external-datasource-service.ts` (this lane), and the door a user walks through is a `packages/cli` command. The dev declares the FULL face it touches in its report; if the fix must change `packages/cli` behaviour beyond calling the corrected emitter, it says so rather than widening on its own.

Take basis, North Star clause 3 live (open P0 4 / P1 34, read this act): clause 3 bars p2/p3 TOOLING and CONTRACT-HYGIENE cards. This is neither — the emitted artefact is what an author receives, and it is the shape a ruling REFUSES.

⛔ Zero `packages/spec` in this lane.

## Review — ACCEPT on the code; landing held on CI convergence only

`Reviewed-by:` `domain:services` PM seat · `session_01AhQASwqJr2Z7XfGWUdvnbF` · 2026-09-23T03:07Z
`Implemented-by:` PR #19776 @ `78a7783cd5`

Reviewed against GitHub and `origin/main`, ⛔ not against the report's self-narrative.

### Verified, each by its own read

- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #19723`. Whole-body closing-keyword scan: **one** hit. `Fixes` is right — the card is implemented whole.
- **Scope.** 4 changed files from the API: the emitter, two of its test files, one changeset. ⛔ No `packages/spec`, ⛔ no `packages/cli`, ⛔ no `content/docs/releases/**`.
- **No new exported symbol.** Diffed the touched module's `^export` lines before vs after: **IDENTICAL**. ⇒ the mechanical floor (`contract-review.md:12`) is not tripped and the claim's `Clause-②: no` stands. (The `+export` lines the diff shows are inside emitted STRING literals and test fixtures, not module scope — that distinction is the whole reading.)
- **The emitted shape is now the authorised one**: `import type { ServiceObject }` → `import { ObjectSchema }`, and `const X: ServiceObject = {` → `export const X = ObjectSchema.create({`, with `export default` dropped.
- **The two choices that could have quietly broken it are both argued in-tree, not merely done.** The import is a **value** import, because `import type` is elided at compile time and the emitted module would throw on its own first line. The export is **named with no `export default`**, because the scaffolded barrel re-exports by name and a second export form is the parallel shape the ruling closed. ⇒ this is the difference between emitting the right-looking shape and emitting a file that actually works.
- **⛔ No comment left contradicting the code.** `renderObjectSource`'s docblock claimed `tsc` over the string was a complete acceptance instrument. It no longer is — the factory parses at evaluation — and the docblock now says so. The `#11000` primary-key tombstone above it moved with it too.
- **Lane split, verified independently rather than accepted.** `packages/cli/src/commands/datasource/introspect.ts:80` writes `draft.source` **verbatim** and `:83` logs it; its only `export default` (`:21`) is the oclif Command class. ⇒ pure pass-through, ⛔ no cli change owed here, and its description/examples stay true.

### Hold — CI has not converged

At `78a7783cd5`: 12 success, 3 skipped, **16 `in_progress`** (`Lint & Repo Gates`, the four `Type Check · *`, `Test Core (1..6/6)`, `Build Core`, the Dogfood gates, Temporal Conformance). **Zero failures so far.** Per the review rules that is an honest draft-time reading, ⛔ not a rework reason. ⛔ Not flipped to ready, ⛔ no auto-merge, ⛔ not enqueued.

### Out-of-scope findings — both verified, ⛔ neither filed as a new card

The dev reported two `class: b` items against `packages/cli` and, correctly, neither filed nor deduped them. I measured both on `origin/main` and both are real:

- `os init` / `os generate` still emit the refused annotated literal — already carried by **#19722** (`open`, `domain:cli`, `pm:queue`), so ⛔ nothing to file.
- Three places **pin the refused spelling** and will redden #19722's PR if not repointed with it: `packages/cli/src/utils/emitted-source-parses.ts:14`, `packages/cli/test/generate-emission-parses.test.ts:148`, `packages/cli/test/generate-refuses-unparseable-name.test.ts:255`.

Per the filing gate — 「⛔ 不是卡:既有卡一条评论能承载的指针/知会/请求;那条评论即其记录」 — that went to #19722 as `issuecomment-5788276757`, ⛔ not as a new card. The `domain:cli` grading and scheduling are ⛔ not this seat's to touch.

### Landing to-do recorded now

On green: flip ready → attach auto-merge only after `mergeable_state` settles → confirm `added_to_merge_queue` → landing is delivery on `origin/main` with **parent count 1**, ⛔ never the PR-closed event. `Fixes` closes the card; `pm:dispatched` is then stripped by hand and read back (it survived the close on 7 of the last 8 landings).
